scope: All present data/weapons.json leaves for rpm, tacRld, emptyRld, reloadSpeed, burstRounds, burstRpm and burstBurstsPerMinute. Exact identity from 1.4.3 roster; KSG is source reference only and has no site leaf.

sourceArtifacts.fullTimingDetailPinNote: Original pinned owner-selector detail was regenerated by accidental unguarded script import; prior bytes were not restored. Current detail identity is updated and compared with final per-leaf rows.

findings.rpm: 55 direct RateOfFire + VSSM RateOfFireForSingleFire agree within 0.01; six bolt-action rows plus M87A1 have bolt-cycle model reproductions; see detail for per-weapon exact values and offsets. All 63 classified; historical Sym1.4.2 deltas remain in selector supplement and are build-separated.
findings.reload: Tac: 45 exact candidate matches, 18 site-vs-candidate mismatches. Empty: 47 exact candidate matches, 13 mismatches (60 non-null; 3 null). Every row records exact raw values/offsets and all ReloadInfoArray entries. Delay/PostReloadDelay sums are not applied globally.
findings.reloadSpeed: 63 values are literal 1.0; no sim consumer of `weapon.reloadSpeed` found in searched simulator source. Provenance unknown; classify as unused software field, not runtime mechanic.
findings.burst: 17 values. BurstRounds: 5 numeric matches on opaque WB integer field Field_16e6fa59, 5 mismatches; semantic source mapping unproven. BurstRpm/BurstsPerMinute mostly disagree with current fields; only exact current matches are classified as sourced config. All rows include paths/offsets/bytes and remain field-by-field reviewable.

limits: Field path and raw offset prove serialized location/bytes, not meaning or engine activation.
Reload differences require phase-timing capture or consumer trace; gameplay must separate trigger start, ammo commit, animation end, and next-fire eligibility.
KSG is reference-only with no site output.
